title: CY41012: Molecular Thermodynamics And Kinetics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite : CY41003
Review of classical thermodynamics; Third law of thermodynamics and residual
entropy; Introduction to Statistical thermodynamics; Thermodynamic quantities
from partition functions; Applications to gases, solids, atomic liquids and
polymers. Chemical equilibrium; Chemical kinetics and molecular reaction
dynamics; Theories of chemical reaction rates.
Book: Physical Chemistry by P.W. Atkins; Physical Chemistry: Statistical
mechanics by H. Metiu; Physical Chemistry: Chemical Kinetics by H. Metiu.
